blocks.text: Elgin Chantrell Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Elgin Chantrell is a combined board name, not a City plan area; officials use the two names separately.
It sits around Crescent Road, 137 Street, 24 Avenue and 32 Avenue, the Nicomekl River north.
Chantrell Creek drains the upland between 132 and 140 Streets into the Nicomekl, named for farmer Harry Chantrell.

blocks.text: Elgin Chantrell Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: RA subdivision minimums: 4,050 square metre lot, 50 metre width, 60 metre depth.
A coach house is allowed on an RA lot: 35 to 75 square metres, up to 120 where the house under-uses floor area.

blocks.text: Elgin Chantrell Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The City maintains the Nicomekl's south-bank dikes to Elgin Park; City dikes are public, district dikes closed.
Sunnyside Acres Urban Forest Park, 2598 144 Street, is 140 hectares of forest, protected by a 1988 vote.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Elgin Chantrell?
faq.a: The Fraser Valley Real Estate Board counted 74 houses listed in Elgin Chantrell at the end of October 2026. The number changes daily, so ask Jared for today’s count.

faq.q: Is Elgin Chantrell a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Elgin Chantrell had a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Elgin Chantrell from June to October 2026?
faq.a: Elgin Chantrell accounted for 38 of the 294 houses sold across South Surrey and White Rock from June to October 2026.

faq.q: Which schools are in Elgin Chantrell itself?
faq.a: Chantrell Creek Elementary and Elgin Park Secondary both sit inside the area, at 2575 137 Street (Kindergarten to Grade 7) and 13484 24 Avenue (Grades 8 to 12), per the Ministry's district list. A school inside the area is not the same as catchment, which the district sets by home address.

faq.q: Can I subdivide an acreage lot into small lots?
faq.a: No — the RA zone keeps subdivision at acreage scale. Surrey Zoning Bylaw No. 12000 sets the minimum lot at 4,050 square metres, with 50-metre width and 60-metre depth minimums and a maximum density of 2.5 lots per hectare, so the lot does not split into city-size lots.

faq.q: Is a low river-edge lot a normal lot?
faq.a: No — treat it as a floodplain lot until checked. The City states much of the Nicomekl lowland is very close to sea level because it was historically an intertidal zone, and it has built dikes and pump stations under its lowlands flood plan since 1997.

faq.q: What is the heritage building on Crescent Road?
faq.a: The Historic Stewart Farm inside Elgin Heritage Park, at 13723 Crescent Road. The Canadian Register lists an 1894 farmhouse with seven associated farm buildings there, formally recognized in 1985, as the only intact farm complex from the late nineteenth century remaining in Surrey.

faq.q: What did houses in Elgin Chantrell sell for?
faq.a: From November 2025 to late October 2026, Elgin Chantrell recorded 59 house sales at a median of $2,280,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Elgin Chantrell?
faq.a: Half sold in 39 days or less, at a median 94.6% of the last list price; 2% went over asking (sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026).
